register_row_retest.canonical_row_before: P-03 - classifications C-36+C-10+A+C-20, 'No B or C-9 on this licence; confirm restoration party and contract structure.'
register_row_retest.cslb_reading_2026_11_10: TARO GROUP INC dba HEISE'S PLUMBING, 1610 EVANS AVE, SAN FRANCISCO 94124, phone (415) 333-0704, Corporation, issued 09/04/2014, expires 09/30/2028, 'This license is current and active.', classifications C36 - PLUMBING, C10 - ELECTRICIAN, A - GENERAL ENGINEERING, C20 - WARM AIR HEATING AND AIR CONDITIONING. No B. No C-9. No complaint, judgment, arbitration or disciplinary action. No Additional Status.
register_row_retest.correction_this_session_supplies: The canonical caveat is correct on the facts but incomplete on the law. Under BPC 7059(a) a licensed specialty contractor may 'take and execute a contract involving the use of two or more crafts or trades, if the performance of the work in the crafts or trades, other than in which they are licensed, is incidental and supplemental to the performance of the work in the craft for which the specialty contractor is licensed.' A C-36-only firm may therefore lawfully include a small access-hole patch in the plumbing contract; a separately priced drywall, texture and paint restoration is not incidental and needs a C-9 or B holder (16 CCR Div. 8 Art. 3 puts 'taping and texturing operations' inside C-9).
